name: Synchrony Financial
description: Synchrony issues store and brand credit cards and promotional financing for retailers and health providers (Lowe's, PayPal, Amazon, Sam's Club, CareCredit and others), lends against them through Synchrony Bank, funded by $81.1B of deposits. Its revenue is interest and fees on card balances ($21.7B in 2025, about 15 percent net interest margin), from which it pays retailers a share ($4.0B retailer share arrangements) and books credit losses ($5.2B provision, 5.65 percent net charge-off rate). Its retail partners share in the economics of the card programs through the retailer share arrangements.

sub.name: Card issuers, consumer lenders and captive finance arms

employees.note: 'Over 20,000 full-time employees' (10-K); exact count not stated in the text read.

businessLines.name: Home & Auto
businessLines.how: Private-label and co-brand credit cards and promotional financing at home-improvement, furniture, flooring, appliance, automotive-service and similar merchants (Lowe's for 46 years, Ashley, Floor & Decor, Mattress Firm, Chevron, Discount Tire); Synchrony earns interest and late fees on revolving balances, shares part with the merchant, and absorbs the credit losses.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), interest and fees on loans

businessLines.name: Digital
businessLines.how: Cards and pay-over-time financing embedded at online partners (PayPal including Venmo for 21 years, Amazon, QVC Group, Verizon, Virgin Red); interest and fees on balances are the revenue, with retailer share and credit losses as the main costs.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), interest and fees on loans

businessLines.name: Diversified & Value
businessLines.how: Cards at large value retailers (Belk, Fleet Farm, JCPenney, OnePay at Walmart, Sam's Club, TJX); interest and fees on revolving balances, offset by retailer sharing and loyalty costs; the largest platform by purchase volume (62.0B).

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), interest and fees on loans

businessLines.name: Health & Wellness
businessLines.how: Healthcare payments and financing through a network of providers and retail locations for people and their pets (CareCredit-branded private label card, partners such as Walgreens); interest and fees on balances are the revenue; dental accounts for 49 percent of the platform's interest and fees and no partner exceeds 0.7 percent of the company's total.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), interest and fees on loans

businessLines.name: Lifestyle
businessLines.how: Custom credit programs for national and regional retailers, manufacturers and industry associations in power sports, outdoor power equipment, sporting goods, apparel, jewelry and music; interest and fees on balances.

revenue.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), interest and fees on loans

brands.name: Synchrony Bank
brands.note: The deposit-taking and lending bank subsidiary funding the card programs.

brands.name: CareCredit
brands.note: Health and Wellness platform brand (named in the platform description of the 10-K; the platform's revenue is 3,783M or 17.5 percent of interest and fees).

brands.name: Synchrony Car Care network and Synchrony HOME card

whatsNext.text: Acquisition of the Lowe's commercial co-branded credit card portfolio (about $0.8B of loan receivables), expected to close in the first half of 2026
